model.name: DRY single-source app version via ONE typed Config scenario unit — all consumers generated/derived, never hand-copied
model.description: TYPED single-source-of-truth for the app version, correct-by-construction (Tron 2026-07-21 principle + architect design 23c7873da APPROVED). ROOT the incident exposed: the version was SCATTERED across >=4 hand-maintained locations that desynced (package.json version stray-edited to 0.7.99, sw.js CACHE_NAME 0.7.102, build-manifest, /api/config per-request package.json read) -> phantom update-available/downgrade + broken PWA. Scattered = fragile by construction. FIX: the version lives in ONE typed scenario unit (ior:class:Config, schema-typed version field) = THE source; build.mjs ATOMICALLY GENERATES every consumer (package.json version, sw.js CACHE_NAME, build-manifest, a bundle-const __BUILD_VERSION__) from it (never hand-copied, like requirements.md is a generated view); /api/config + any version display READ the build-stamped __BUILD_VERSION__ (NOT a per-request package.json read — that per-request read is EXACTLY what let a stray file edit make served LIE = Tron phantom; reading the build-stamp = served equals what was actually BUILT+deployed, by construction). Accepted tradeoff (PO): version changes only via build/deploy, never a hand-edit (no-restart-pickup is CORRECT). A guard (INV-V1/V2/V3) asserts unit==pkg==sw==manifest==HEAD AND working-tree-clean, failing LOUDLY on divergence — this roots the served==committed==SW==unit phantom-guard in ONE source and hardens the landmine (verifies working-tree==HEAD, not just the version string). Generalizes: configs = typed scenario units (schema-validated, the ONE config mechanism, data-on-disk-is-truth), version FIRST, extend as practical. SUPERSEDES the earlier R31.7 deploy-runbook framing (single-source-by-construction > runbook discipline; the PID/tree-clean insight is folded into INV-V3). Route: architect designed (23c7873da) -> req formalizes (this) -> expert implements the generator + retires the hand-maintained copies -> tester gates: mutate the ONE source -> every consumer changes; hand-editing any copy is impossible or caught. R31.7 FINAL CLOSURE (design 520bb68c4, PO 2026-07-22, non-blocking): +AC-INV-V4-served-equals-booted — getVersion returns a boot-stamped BOOT_VERSION const (read manifest once at module load), so /api/config reflects the running process version; rebuild-without-restart leaves it unchanged, only a real restart re-reads. Thin impl-edit on getVersion, no new node (expert builds + restart). Capture-gate.
model.tronQuote: > TRON (2026-07-21): "we should always do DRY so ONE single source for the version as much as possible… no scattered fragile locations. scenarios are the ONLY configs we want. TYPED SCENARIOS."

discoverySource.note: DRY single-source typed version; rooted in the phantom-update incident (version scattered across >=4 hand-maintained desynced locations). Supersedes the deploy-runbook framing.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The app version lives in ONE typed scenario unit (ior:class:Config, schema-typed version field) = THE single source of truth. No other location holds an authored version; every other occurrence is derived.
acceptanceCriteria.metNote: MET: version lives in ONE typed Config unit config-singleton (ior:class:Config); build.mjs:24-25 reads config-singleton.model.version as THE source. Gated by Test 317b67d0 (A). Measured 2026-07-24.

acceptanceCriteria.text: build.mjs ATOMICALLY GENERATES all version consumers from the typed Config unit — package.json version, sw.js CACHE_NAME, build-manifest, and a bundle-const __BUILD_VERSION__ — as a generator step (never hand-edited, like requirements.md is a generated view). They cannot desync because there is one source.
acceptanceCriteria.metNote: MET: build.mjs generateVersion [impl b5eb6953] (build.mjs:17,23) atomically generates package.json version (surgical write-back :28), sw.js CACHE_NAME (:88), build-manifest.version (:69), __BUILD_VERSION__ (:43) from the Config unit. Gated by Test 317b67d0 (A), status:pass. Measured 2026-07-24.

acceptanceCriteria.text: /api/config and any version display READ the build-stamped __BUILD_VERSION__, NOT a per-request package.json read. Served == what was actually BUILT+deployed by construction (the per-request package.json read was EXACTLY what let a stray file edit make served lie = Tron phantom). Accepted tradeoff: version changes via build/deploy only, never a hand-edit.
acceptanceCriteria.metNote: MET: server.ts getVersion (:57-61) reads the BUILD-STAMPED build-manifest.json version, NOT a per-request package.json read — the phantom-7.99 root (per-request package.json read) is removed. /api/config (:1403) + status (:1700) use getVersion. Measured server.ts 2026-07-24. NOTE: distinct from INV-V4 — this read is per-request-of-the-build-stamped-manifest (build-stamped, not editable); INV-V4 adds boot-freezing (still UNBUILT, below).

acceptanceCriteria.text: INV-V1 (derive-equal): unit == package.json version == sw.js CACHE_NAME == build-manifest == __BUILD_VERSION__ — all consumers derive-equal from the one typed Config unit. A guard/CI fails LOUDLY on any inequality.
acceptanceCriteria.metNote: MET: versionGuardAgreement (scripts/start.mjs:97) derive-equal asserts unit==package.json==sw.js==manifest, exit(1) loud on divergence. Gated by Test 317b67d0 (B). Measured start.mjs 2026-07-24.

acceptanceCriteria.text: INV-V2 (served==committed): the generated consumers == HEAD (committed) — no drift between what is built/served and what is committed. Guard fails loudly on divergence.
acceptanceCriteria.metNote: MET (served==committed): satisfied by versionGuardTreeClean (INV-V3, start.mjs:83) asserting the deploy-critical consumers == HEAD (git diff --quiet HEAD -- server.ts/package.json/sw.js/Config-unit) TOGETHER WITH INV-V1 derive-equal — consumers agree AND equal committed => served==committed by construction. Gated by Test 317b67d0 (B). Measured 2026-07-24. (INV-V2's assertion is mechanically the INV-V3 tree-clean-vs-HEAD check; no separate guard needed.)

acceptanceCriteria.text: INV-V3 (tree-clean, SCOPED, landmine hardening): git diff --quiet HEAD -- src/ts/server/server.ts package.json src/public/sw.js (+ optionally the Config unit + build-manifest) — the DEPLOY-CRITICAL generator input+outputs must equal HEAD; a reverted/stray-checkout of any of these fails LOUDLY BEFORE deploy (catches the exact 3-file landmine from the incident: server.ts strip + package.json revert + sw.js revert; a per-file checkout leaves no reflog so this guard is the only catch). SCOPED to the generator input+outputs, NOT the whole working tree — this shared multi-agent repo ALWAYS carries unrelated uncommitted churn (scenario units, merge-visual PNGs, data/logs, dirty since session start); a whole-tree-clean guard would false-positive on EVERY deploy -> get ignored/disabled -> defeated. Team lesson folded: inspect an old version with git show <ref>:<file> (read-only), NEVER git checkout <ref> -- <file> (mutates the tree = the landmine).
acceptanceCriteria.metNote: MET: versionGuardTreeClean (scripts/start.mjs:83) — git diff --quiet HEAD -- [server.ts, package.json, sw.js, CONFIG_UNIT], exit(1) loud; SCOPED to deploy-critical (not whole-tree, correct for the shared churny repo). Gated by Test 317b67d0 (B). Measured start.mjs 2026-07-24.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Configs generally are TYPED SCENARIO UNITS (schema-validated, the ONE config mechanism, consistent with data-on-disk-is-truth) — no scattered hardcoded constants / .env sprawl / ad-hoc JSON / hand-maintained copies. Version is the FIRST; extend to other configs as far as practical.
acceptanceCriteria.metNote: MET (version-first, per the AC's own scoping 'version is the FIRST; extend as far as practical'): the typed-Config-scenario-unit mechanism EXISTS and is proven with the version (config-singleton, ior:class:Config, semver-schema-validated at build.mjs:26 fail-loud). Pattern established; extension to other configs is ongoing/as-practical. Measured 2026-07-24.

acceptanceCriteria.text: INV-V4 (served==booted): getVersion() returns a BOOT-STAMPED const — at module load, const BOOT_VERSION = (read build-manifest.json ONCE) ?? PKG_VERSION; getVersion() returns BOOT_VERSION (frozen at boot). So /api/config version == the version the RUNNING PROCESS booted with; a rebuild-WITHOUT-restart leaves /api/config UNCHANGED (honest — shows what is actually running), and only a REAL restart re-reads. Closes the last version-lie axis: /api/config becomes a valid deploy signal again (no longer needs the PID/uptime workaround). sw.js CACHE_NAME stays a static build-updated file (correct for PWA client cache-bust) — this fix is only the server self-reported version. Thin impl-edit on getVersion (server.ts:55-59), NO new node; expert builds + a real restart.
acceptanceCriteria.metNote: MET 2026-07-24: getVersion boot-frozen — const BOOT_VERSION module-load IIFE (server.ts:62), getVersion() returns BOOT_VERSION (:68), NOT per-request. Impl f8c198bb -> Test ff91ca36 (r317v4-boot-frozen-version-gate.mjs GREEN DET-3x v0.7.135, source-audit + runtime, non-mutating anti-circular vs architect decoy-injection). Retires the version-lie + verify-by-pid.
